answer: The pulse chain is verified at intake and signal publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 11 epochs old, anchored at a wander checkpoint. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 11 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. That is 1266 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
